items.title: Metasploit Releases 7 New Exploit Modules covering FreePBX, Cacti and SmarterMail
items.description: The latest update to the Metasploit Framework this week provides a significant enhancement for penetration testers and red teamers, introducing seven new exploit modules targeting commonly used enterprise software. The highlight of this release is a sophisticated trio of modules directed at FreePBX, alongside critical remote code execution (RCE) capabilities for Cacti and SmarterMail. This […]…
